meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序编排多步任务,单阶段逐个执行,失败自动重试并续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一批互相依赖的任务,需要按先后顺序自动跑完。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a batch of tasks depend on each other and must run in order.

howto.what: 它能把一个多步请求拆成带依赖关系的任务图:某个节点依赖的节点先完成后,才轮到它执行,Claude 按依赖分波并行跑这些子任务;单个节点失败可单独重试、改写指令或调整定义,已完成节点的结果会被复用而不是重跑。
howto.when: 当你说出「mass-ulw」、要一个任务 DAG,或做分批任务且其中一些任务必须等别的任务先完成时触发。完全互相独立的并行任务,用普通并发就行。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次重构拆成任务图:先审接口,再改实现,最后验证。
say.note: 三个节点按依赖顺序分波执行。

say.text: 把 audit 节点重试一次,指令改成只检查 src/ 目录。
say.note: 该节点用新指令重试,其余结果复用。

howto.what_en: It turns a multi-step request into a dependency graph: nodes run in parallel waves once their dependencies finish, one run per phase, and one failed node can be retried, steered, or amended without redoing finished work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "mass-ulw", a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. Fully independent work is simpler as plain parallel spawns.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to graph this refactor: audit, then rewrite, then verify.
say_en.note: Runs the three nodes in dependency order.

say_en.text: Add a verify node to the docs-refresh run, depending on rewrite.
say_en.note: Only new or changed nodes re-run.

say_en.text: Retry the audit node and change its prompt to only inspect src/.
say_en.note: That node retries with the new prompt.
